Subject: 
E-mail policy of Government of India. 
Ministry of Communication and Information Technology has notified the E-mail policy of 
Government of India in the Gazette of India dated 18.02.2015, which is available at 
http://deity.gov.in/content/email-policy. 
2. 
It is notified by the Ministry of Communication and Information Technology Under heading 
Scope para 2 that "Only the e-mail services provided by NIC, the Implementing Agency of the 
Government of India shall be used for official communications by all Organizations except those 
exempted under clause No. 14 of this policy. The e-mail services provided by other services 
providers shall not be used for any official communications". 
This policy is applicable to all 
employees of Government of India and employees of those 
Governments that use the 
e-mail services of Government of India and also those 
Governments that chose to adopt 
this policy in future. The directives contained in this policy must be followed by all of them with no 
exceptions. 
3. 
All are advised and instructed to follow the directions of Ministry of Communication and 
Information Technology in using the e-mail for official purpose.
